Nexus Setup Resource Give your AI agent a codebase map before it edits anything. GitNexus indexes your repository into a local knowledge graph so A I coding agents can inspect structure before they edit. The goal is simple: stop your agent from changing code blind. What Nexus Helps With GitNexus can help your agent inspect connected files, dependencies, call chains, execution flows, impacted symbols, and likely blast radius before a change. B est Setup For real coding work, use C LI + MC P. Run this from your project root: npx gitnexus analyze npx gitnexus setup Then restart your A I editor or coding agent so it loads the MC P server. Works with agents/editors including C laude C ode, C ursor, C odex, Windsurf, OpenC ode, and A ntigravity. C laude C ode has the deepest integration because GitNexus supports MC P tools, skills, and hooks there. Manual MC P Setup For C laude C ode: macOS / Linux:claude mcp add gitnexus -- npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp Windows:claude mcp add gitnexus -- cmd /c npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp For C odex: codex mcp add gitnexus -- npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp For faster startup, install GitNexus globally and run setup instead: npm install -g gitnexus gitnexus setup What To Tell Your A gent “B efore you modify this codebase, use GitNexus to inspect the relevant symbols, dependencies, execution flows, and blast radius. If the index is stale, ask me before re-indexing. Do not make broad changes until you understand what the touched code connects to.” Safety Notes GitNexus is a map, not a guarantee. Still run tests, review diffs, and check risky changes manually. GitNexus C LI + MC P indexing is designed for local workflows.
